metadata.rebaselined_default_cleanup: 2026-10-17: cce_center_*um 0.98552834 -> 0.95346904 (-3.25 %). The 2D builder defaults are now the full default stack (DEFAULT_STACK = DeviceConfig(): p+ 0.3 um, graded 2.974271e15 / 6.335936e13 / 0.987 um, n+ 1 um 1e19); the previous value froze a mix that was neither DeviceConfig() nor legacy_config() (builder geometry p+ 1 um / no n+ with the new doping). The 2D entries are therefore a guard of the default model at 10 V (just below its 10.3 V reach-through). cv_1d is unchanged: that test now pins the v3 geometry (p+ 1 um, no n+) explicitly with the v3 doping.
metadata.rebaselined_cv_observable_and_mobility: 2026-10-17: cce_center_*um 0.95346904 -> 0.95377414 (+0.032 %).
